sourceBreakdowns.title: FHA MMI Fund FY2024 business-operations cash flows by quarter and type
sourceBreakdowns.basis: HUD's FY2024 fourth-quarter report to Congress publishes $19.389B of MMI Fund business-operation collections and $13.868B of signed disbursements, for $5.521B net cash flow. The 36 quarter/type rows reconcile exactly at the source's $1M precision and every leaf is below $10B. HUD calls these figures unaudited and warns that timing and source differences prevent a full reconciliation to other tables; this panel is therefore not an additive child of Treasury's -$27.415B FHA MMI Capital Reserve cash-outlay classification.

sourceBreakdowns.title: HUD 2024 Housing Choice Voucher renewal eligibility by state and territory
sourceBreakdowns.basis: HUD's authority-level award list reports $26.625444529B of 2024 prorated Housing Choice Voucher renewal eligibility after offsets across 2,075 Public Housing Authorities. These 55 state and territory totals reconcile exactly to the published authority rows. The list is a source-native eligibility view within HUD's broader $30B renewal-funding announcement, not an additive child of Treasury's $33.976B FY2024 Tenant Based Rental Assistance cash outlay.

sourceBreakdowns.title: USAspending FY2024 HUD Contract Renewals gross outlays by Treasury account
sourceBreakdowns.basis: USAspending's FY2024 Contract Renewals program activity reconciles exactly to two permanent-indefinite Treasury accounts after all 15 TAS under HUD accounts 086-0302 and 086-0303 are checked. Both same-basis leaves remain above $10B and the TAS endpoint's only child object class repeats each total, so they are labeled public TAS disclosure ceilings. The separate HCV state panel uses eligibility rather than gross outlays and is not additive here.
